name: Val-Du Lakes Campground
note: Wooded campground with grassy sites at 1573 N Wilson Rd near Mears, a few miles inland from Silver Lake and its dunes, with its own bar & grill within walking distance; every site has 30-amp electric, picnic table and fire ring; some full-hookup sites and rental campers. Daily $40/night for 2 adults + children, full hookup $80; holiday weeks $60 with 3-4 night minimums. RV Life 4.5*/$$$ ~$43/night (auto 9/2026); Google 4.2 over 132 reviews. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: valdulakes.com/campground (read 2026-09-30, confirmed by AWH): daily rate $40/night, each site has 30 AMP electric; FHU $80 -> real transient RV campground; published base $40 (2026) <= $50; quality: RV Life 4.5* on 4 reviews, Google Maps 4.2 over 132 reviews (count read by AWH)
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 700 m frame) at 43.6747,-86.4595: the site area is under canopy in the woods east of the N Wilson Rd junction, with farm fields north and a horse farm south; no lake or stream in frame (Silver Lake is several km west) - not waterfront. RV Life's pin (on the fields) and Google's (on the horse farm) both missed; pin set from the geocoded address into the woods

lead.note: canopy; pin approximate within the wooded tract

name: Best Bear Resort
note: Lodge, cabins and campground at 10642 N Merriville Rd near Irons in the Manistee National Forest, on the ORV and snowmobile trail network; a newly built RV resort of about 62 full-hookup pull-through sites alongside older campground loops. RV Resort FHU pull-through $49/night, tax included. Not on RV Life; Google 4.9 over 590 reviews (the resort as a whole). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: bestbearresort.com: RV Resort full-hookup pull-through sites $49/night tax incl., 62 sites, online booking -> real transient RV campground; published base $49 (2026) <= $50; quality: Google Maps 4.9 over 590 reviews
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 900 m frame, winter tiles) at 44.1410,-85.8237: pine forest with campground loops east of the Merriville Rd crossroads; no water in frame - not waterfront. Pin is Google's resort point in that loop area; AWH 2026-09-30: Google imagery shows several big loops side by side, which one is the new RV resort is not obvious, so the pin marks the campground area rather than a specific loop

lead.note: pin = campground area, not a specific loop
